# NEAR Private OTC

> Private OTC deal board on NEAR testnet. The board (signed-in users only) shows pair, side, expiry and counter-offer count only. Deals can be public (listed on the board) or private (link only, never listed; maker can switch private to public, not back). Expiry options: 2 min (demo), 1h, 24h, 7d, enforced by the verifier via the signed intent deadline. Exact terms and counter-offers are sealed to an OutLayer TEE enclave and revealed only to signed-in parties. Matching NEP-413 signed token_diff intents settle atomically via execute_intents on a NEAR Intents verifier (otcdesk-intents.testnet).

## Key facts
- Verifier: otcdesk-intents.testnet (near/intents defuse v0.4.2 release wasm)
- Relayer: otcdesk.testnet
- Tokens: otcdesk-usdc.testnet (tUSDC), otcdesk-eth.testnet (tETH), wrap.testnet (wNEAR)
- Enclave: OutLayer project otcdesk-enclave.testnet/private-otc, pubkey 03312dd677a5864ffc8cff352b7419b90896c9aee20e4f79308c1106517a4947e8
- Sign-in: Privy (email or Google) → NEAR implicit account

## Pages
- [Board](/app): open deals (coarse info)
- [New deal](/app/new)
- [My deals](/app/mine)
- [Wallet](/app/wallet): balances, faucet (tUSDC, tETH, wNEAR), activity

## API
- GET /api/health
- GET /api/prices — reference USD prices (CoinGecko, cached 30 s)
- GET /api/deals — public board
- GET /api/deals/{id}
